시편 105:1.content: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

시편 105:2.content: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

시편 105:3.content: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

시편 105:4.content: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

시편 105:5.content: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

시편 105:6.content: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

시편 105:7.content: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

시편 105:8.content: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

시편 105:9.content: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

시편 105:10.content: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

시편 105:11.content: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

시편 105:12.content: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

시편 105:13.content: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

시편 105:14.content: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

시편 105:15.content: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

시편 105:16.content: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

시편 105:17.content: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

시편 105:18.content: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

시편 105:19.content: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.

시편 105:20.content: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

시편 105:21.content: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

시편 105:22.content: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

시편 105:23.content: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

시편 105:24.content: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

시편 105:25.content: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

시편 105:26.content: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

시편 105:27.content: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

시편 105:28.content: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

시편 105:29.content: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

시편 105:30.content: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

시편 105:31.content: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

시편 105:32.content: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

시편 105:33.content: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

시편 105:34.content: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

시편 105:35.content: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

시편 105:36.content: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

시편 105:37.content: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

시편 105:38.content: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

시편 105:39.content: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

시편 105:40.content: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

시편 105:41.content: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

시편 105:42.content: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

시편 105:43.content: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

시편 105:44.content: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

시편 105:45.content: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.
